title: Auto Claim - First Notice of Loss
subtitle: Online claim submission

sections.heading: Loss details
fields: Intersection of Cedar Ave and Summit St, Brightwater, OR

sections.heading: What happened (in your own words)
sections.paragraph: I was stopped at the red light on Summit St at Cedar Ave, heading north, when a silver minivan behind me did not stop in time and hit the back of my car. The rear bumper is pushed in, the trunk lid is crumpled and will not close properly and both tail lights are broken. I was able to drive the car home. Nobody was hurt. A Brightwater police officer came and took a report.

sections.heading: Damage to your vehicle
fields: Rear bumper pushed in; trunk lid crumpled and will not latch; both tail lights broken.
Did the vehicle have damage before this incident that has not been repaired?

sections.heading: Repair and rental
fields: Riverton Falls Collision Center, Riverton Falls, OR
Yes, while the car is being repaired

declaration: I confirm that the information in this report is true and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that Contoso Insurance will review this claim under the terms of my policy.
